source.publication: 2025 MI-1040 Forms and Instructions (includes Form 4884 instructions)
source.section: Form 4884 Section A lines 9-16 (PDF page 20 'Recipients born before 1946': private benefits up to 65,897 single; PDF page 21 Line 9, Line 16); Schedule 1 lines 14, 27, 28 (PDF page 14, PDF page 17); MI-1040 lines 9a, 10, 13-17 (PDF page 10 Line 9a, Line 10, Line 17; PDF page 11 example: line 14 income subject to tax less line 15 exemptions = line 16 taxable income)

worked: Federal AGI = private pension 30,000.00 + IRA distribution 10,000.00 + interest 15,000.00 + taxable Social Security 20,400.00 = 75,400.00. Federal taxable income = 75,400.00 - federal standard deduction (15,750 + 1 x 2,000 age 65 or older = 17,750.00) = 57,650.00; given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored. Michigan (born 1944: Section A): line 9 limit 65,897.00; line 10 military/railroad 0.00; public benefits 0.00; private benefits (pension 30,000.00 + IRA after 59 1/2 10,000.00) = 40,000.00, under the 65,897.00 room, so all 40,000.00 carried to Schedule 1 line 27. Line 14 Social Security 20,400.00. Line 28 worksheet: 14,688 - line 27 40,000.00 < 0, so 0.00. Subtractions 60,400.00. Line 14 = 75,400.00 - 60,400.00 = 15,000.00; exemption 5,800.00; line 16 = 9,200.00. MI-1040 line 17 tax = 9,200.00 x 0.0425 = 391.00. No credits; state income tax 391.00.
